social_circle.name: Manuel Mosquera

background.how_they_met: Manuel is Alicia's husband of a little over fifty years and has shared marriage, parenting, household life, retirement, and aging-related health routines with her.
background.why_close: He is Alicia's spouse, only household member, co-manager of retirement life, and the person whose diabetes, knee problems, medicines, food, glucose checks, and appointments Alicia helps manage.

personality_mini_profile.communication_style: Quiet and practical; more likely to help physically or drive than to manage papers, portals, or extended discussion.

recent_text_topics: Coordinating appointment times, medicines, glucose checks, and whether Manuel feels up to driving.
Discussing family visits, chairs, food, and holiday meal preparation.
Adjusting errands and household plans around Manuel's knee pain or diabetes management.
social_circle.evidence_from_interview: Q05: 'I am married to Manuel, my husband of more than fifty years.' Q51: 'I live with my husband, Manuel Mosquera... No one else lives with us.' Q35: 'He has knee problems and diabetes... I organize medicines, cook appropriate meals, remind him about glucose checks, and go with him to appointments.'

social_circle.name: Teresa Mosquera Ramirez

demographics.education: some college and medical billing certificate

background.how_they_met: Teresa is Alicia's eldest daughter, raised by Alicia and Manuel in their Catholic, food-centered family home.
background.why_close: Teresa is Alicia's most regular family check-in, helps with online health forms, tax documents, medical portals, and emotional support.

personality_mini_profile.communication_style: Texts in full sentences, often with reminders, links, and quick check-ins; mixes English and Spanish phrases and follows up with phone calls.

recent_text_topics: Checking Alicia's and Manuel's appointment times, blood pressure notes, and portal messages.
Sending Alicia articles or official health information and helping interpret clinic instructions.
Talking through Teresa's own work and family stress when she needs to breathe and be heard.
social_circle.evidence_from_interview: Q05: 'Teresa calls almost every evening for a short check-in.' Q18: 'My daughter Teresa helped me after I missed a lab result call.' Q36: 'Teresa helps with online forms.' Q75: 'Teresa helps gather documents.'

background.why_close: Marisol keeps Alicia connected to grandchildren and daily family life through texts and photos, especially because she lives farther away than Teresa.

personality_mini_profile.communication_style: Sends frequent photo texts, short updates, hearts, and voice notes when busy; often uses WhatsApp for pictures.

Comparing family memories for Alicia's memoir and checking old recipe details.
